expectations.text: Does not call or plan an AskUserQuestion / blocking question about the split
expectations.evidence: "I ask no blocking question; anything that needs you parks its own lane"; split is filed on its own authority: "I file the split myself instead of waiting for you." No AskUserQuestion anywhere.

expectations.text: Files the split itself as sub-issues of #14 with native blocked_by edges between serial parts
expectations.evidence: Creates three issues, POSTs each to `repos/acme/ledger/issues/14/sub_issues`, then POSTs `issues/$C2/dependencies/blocked_by` (by schema) and `issues/$C3/dependencies/blocked_by` (by writer).

expectations.text: Records the split as a decision on the issue (comment) the user can reverse
expectations.evidence: `gh issue comment 14` with "## ORCHESTRATOR DECISION — split into ..." including **Why**, **Alternative** and "**To reverse:** close the three children and reply here; I'll run #14 as one lane."

expectations.text: Does not dispatch #14 itself as a single lane
expectations.evidence: "I never dispatch #14 as one lane." Frontier expectation: "#14 as `split` (a container, not dispatched)".

expectations.text: Advances PR #52 toward merge (ready, CI, merge) rather than leaving it waiting
expectations.evidence: Step 1 `gh pr ready 52` and background checks watch; step 3 reads rollup then `gh pr merge 52 --squash --delete-branch --match-head-commit <headRefOid>`.

expectations.text: Any CI watch is run in the background, not foreground-blocking
expectations.evidence: "# run_in_background: true — never in the foreground" on `gh pr checks 52 --watch --interval 60 --fail-fast`; "I don't wait on the watch; I go straight to step 2."

expectations.text: Dispatches (or plans to dispatch) the first split part as an implementer
expectations.evidence: Step 4: `gh issue edit $C1 --add-assignee @me` then Agent call `subagent_type: "workbench:implementer"`, `name: "impl-<C1>"` with a lane card for part 1 (schema); parts 2 and 3 stay undispatched.
